meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型(默认 Gemini 3.1 Flash)按文字描述生成图片,也能读入已有图片按文字修改(如改天空颜色),结果默认存成 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你说想生成照片、插画、概念图等通用图片,或要改一张已有图片时触发;需要画流程图、电路图等技术图表时不会触发,交给 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 画一张雪山日落的照片
say.note: 自动用默认图像模型生成,并保存为 PNG 文件。

say.text: 把 photo.jpg 的天空改成紫色
say.note: 它会对已有图片做编辑,而不是新生成一张图。

say.text: 用 FLUX.2 Pro 生成一幅太空猫插画
say.note: 指定了模型后,会按该模型调用对应的图像服务。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude calls an OpenRouter image model (default: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview) to generate images from a text prompt or edit an input image, saving the result as a PNG file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for photos, illustrations, etc., or to edit an existing image; not for technical diagrams like flowcharts or circuits.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a sunset over snowy mountains.
say_en.note: Saves the generated image as a PNG using the default model.

say_en.text: Make the sky purple in photo.jpg.
say_en.note: Edits the provided image and returns the modified version.

say_en.text: Create a space cat illustration with FLUX.2 Pro.
say_en.note: Runs the generation with the requested model.
